body:
The earlier affinity fit produced nearly constant outputs and mixed supervision obscured which parameters had trained. This PR adds a modular, directly supervised model, explicit measurement/context contracts, training-support checks, and reproducible exact-versus-sampled peptide-availability experiments. It remains **draft**: the qualified biological system specified in #130 and #132 is incomplete.

## Model and data flow

- Shared sequence representations feed direct affinity/stability heads. Class II evaluates sliding registers and flanks; class I retains whole-peptide context.
- Optional annotation heads predict molecular species/context with explicit supplied values and overrides. Full paired-TCR scoring conditions on the receptor before pMHC-register pooling; validated TCR cohorts and TCRvdb access remain pending.
- APC inputs distinguish species, cell type, concurrent machinery states and cytokine exposure. Defaults carry provenance; supplied states override assumptions. Purified binding remains separate from APC context.
- Processing and MS response have separate features/readouts. Raw assay targets, training-only scaling, subset-specific allocation, feature/parameter support and compatible checkpoint transfer make the trained scope explicit. Exact resume retains optimizer/sampler/RNG state; GPU bitwise equivalence is not established.
- Biological sources use shared Hitlist query/materialization contracts with source quantities, missingness, inequalities, reused contributors, conflicting copies, parent alternatives and material uncertainty preserved.
- Experimental exact and sampled processing models cover short fragments/nonbinders. They are not yet fully integrated into mixed-assay training, and their inferred quantities are not validated APC concentrations.

## Biological evidence

| Task | Held-out result | Scope and limitation |
|---|---|---|
| Local IC50, one epoch | RMSE1.1613 vs ridge1.2291 log10(nM); Spearman.5117 | Inspected peptide-disjoint splits/shared studies; class-II recall.0882 and0/203bounds satisfied. Full convergence/qualification unresolved. |
| HAP1 knockout response | TestRMSE.573380 vs calibrated precursor.631249;9.167%gain;Spearman.46623 | Same-study molecular-component holdout, known knockout conditions; mechanistic ERAP augmentation adds no gain. |
| Non-MHC measured MS1 | TestRMSE.449828 vs length.520456;13.57%gain;Spearman.52564 | Four held-out synthesized pools; purity/load/response confounded, not pure detector calibration or cellular transfer. |
| Newer MAPP baseline composition | Exact testRMSE.415095 vs uniform.439892;5.637%gain | Observed-candidate composition only. Sequence vs length improves4.334%, missing fixed5%criterion. REINFORCE has no advantage. |
| Native-cell chemical response | Exact testRMSE.243207 vs condition.250953 | Small gain; combined exact/bounded loss improves0.59%; not intracellular concentrations. |
| Macrophage MHC-I response | Processing+precursor testRMSE.139278 vs condition.120011 | Failed; almost constant without precursor. |
| **Intact product/substrate kinetics** | **Fragmentation testRMSE.359038 vs direct regression.228184** | **Failed.** Same-peptide future-time forecast, one substrate/preparation. Change-from-last Spearman-.13886 vs direct.23071. |

The latest kinetic comparison includes14physical fits and7controls,626training/181validation/186test original measurements. Validation selects the comparator and physical variant; models and predictions are sealed before predictive outcome access. All801states per physical fit and all predictions remain. Conditional-score methods retain exact forward probabilities/residuals, match the failed exact result, and cost1.8–2.5× core runtime. They are hybrids, not simulator-only RL or GRPO.

[Full kinetic report, checkpoints, predictions, plot and independent replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/d67fb48488960882481627c6f3a8bdaeb6e58bd3/experiments/2026-10-25_0046_codex_intact-kinetic-forecast/README.md).

A separately registered training-only diagnostic tests optimizer error and the model's forced increasing/concave curves. Six L-BFGS fits improve training MSE only2.29–2.32%, below the5%materiality rule. The descriptive shape penalty is7.98–7.99%of original physical MSE, below the10%rule. Flexible per-peptide curves fit much better, motivating a representation/rate-sharing test rather than claiming a diagnosed biological cause. No held-out file is read or replacement biological score reported.

[Full diagnostic, numerical certificates and every training prediction](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/d67fb48488960882481627c6f3a8bdaeb6e58bd3/experiments/2026-10-25_0116_codex_intact-shape-diagnostic/README.md).

Synthetic exact/REINFORCE references, clipping×group-standardization factorials, reuse, reference-KL, partial-observation, multiset and hybrid experiments remain archived. Their numerical success is separate from biological validation. The [canonical experiment registry](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/a23bc160a8c31408b82cab663ea968093a624f36/experiments/experiment_log.md) records all cohorts, failures, historical exposure, conditions and reproducibility bundles.

## Verification and remaining work

Kinetic source replay verifies993targets and all original admission decisions. Independent reconstruction verifies13,902physical predictions plus seven controls,126metric records, every Adam recurrence and all exact gradients; sampled draws are not independently replayed. Diagnostic replay checks3,756predictions,246function objectives, final finite-difference gradients and convex shape optimality. All fixed numerical gates pass; this does not override failed biological screens.

Shared intact source [Hitlist832](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/832) is merged after full hosted checks; its2.0.33 release-build40149903223 also passed. Hitlist2.0.33 is now published and both PyPI distributions are byte-identical to the tested build. The first6.7MBartifact download failed when the shared disk filled; its partial bytes remain preserved. A fresh download passed source-provenance, license and Twine checks before upload. The shared Python installation was not changed. Registered kinetic recipe [Hitlist833](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/833) passed all hosted checks and merged as759ceae4; its2.0.34 release-build40151233071 passed, the release is published, and both PyPI distributions are byte-identical to the tested artifacts. The27final focused tests and earlier32-test focused run pass, with frozen runtime hashes unchanged after rebase. The earlier full local Hitlist suite was deferred for storage; both exact releases passed full hosted checks. No shared environment was changed. Hitlist2.0.31/2.0.32 published artifacts are byte-verified against tested builds. Presto CI40150595924 passed atd67fb48. The3201c44checkpoint failed lint on archived storage helpers;19b158b preserves their exact executed bytes and formats AST-equivalent working copies. Both hosted CI runs at19b158b now pass. All eligible tracked files plus the seven new maintenance helpers pass local lint/format. Cleanup and experiment evidence is pushed at8454ef9c40913c89d56bca5cd02f923701af91f6; both hosted checks passed.

The [temporal-representation comparison](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/8454ef9c40913c89d56bca5cd02f923701af91f6/experiments/2026-10-25_0143_codex_intact-temporal-representation/README.md) is now complete. It uses only the original training cohort: 463 changes for96peptides, supplied first-time baselines, five peptide folds and nested ridge selection. Sequence-conditioned slopes score development RMSE **.345792 vs length .379042** (8.772%gain), Pearson/Spearman **.59918/.59977**, with nonconstant outputs. Four of five folds improve; the paired peptide-bootstrap gain interval **[-4.26%,20.11%]** includes zero. All selected ridge penalties are the largest preregistered value1; the grid was not extended. Removing the physical rate penalty gains only1.362%, below the5%gate. All15selected physical optimizers converge but reach the effective-pre-exposure upper bound. Independent replay checks135direct records,45physical starts,749metric records, selection, bootstrap and all231artifact hashes. This passes a development screen, not independent-protein or blind biological validation; original100/120minute outcomes stay unread.

[Verified storage cleanup](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/8454ef9c40913c89d56bca5cd02f923701af91f6/tasks/storage_cleanup_2026-10-25/README.md) removed about640MiBof regenerable caches/redundant download pieces and shared6.60GiBof logical duplicate content using independent APFS clones. Unique scientific evidence and user edits were preserved. Capacity improved from1.20to5.52GiBat cleanup verification, with concurrent volume changes disclosed. The initially refused prepare attempt remains archived; all six stages subsequently passed the unchanged resource limits. The new experiment reused existing inputs and retained14.46MBof evidence. Historical PXD044463 test descriptive exposure remains recorded; fresh transfer still requires prospective qualification.

Still required: fresh biological transfer; precursor-relative intracellular/APC quantities and observation calibration; useful machinery/transport/clearance contrasts; qualified auxiliary/TCR cohorts; complete affinity/censoring qualification; integrated training and serving/promotion checks. Existing inspected test cohorts remain excluded from further tuning. The direct sequence model is the next transfer comparator; rate-penalty removal did not qualify. Broader measured substrates and a fresh prospective evaluation precede a matched exact/discrete comparison of any new generative representation. No evidence yet establishes an RL advantage or a validated full APC availability/concentration predictor. Completion criteria remain in `tasks/modular_model/completion-spec.md`, `completion-progress.md`, #130 and #132.


## Latest native intracellular source qualification

The [initial source recovery](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/5e3a8c033df364d8b67aab352c4e8b2f92dc8ef7/experiments/2026-10-25_0344_codex_proteasome-quantity-source/README.md) and [original-reference/quantity audit](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/5e3a8c033df364d8b67aab352c4e8b2f92dc8ef7/experiments/2026-10-25_0424_codex_native-psmd2-source/README.md) are published at 5e3a8c033df364d8b67aab352c4e8b2f92dc8ef7. These qualify Sahu2021/PXD018722 native intracellular control/PSMD2-knockdown evidence for the next biological fit; no model trained in these source audits.

- All 74,529 publisher intensity cells match original text, with 40,679 underlying evidence and 10,935 modification-specific rows. Raw and LFQ differ in 30,170 cells; modified forms contribute to some sequence quantities. Aggregation residuals, matching-only evidence, zeros and missing calibration remain explicit. Original text supplies the 13 gene annotations damaged by Excel date conversion.
- The exact 73,113-entry deposited reference has 38,641 candidate peptide spans. Some 6,809 peptides have multiple complete parent sequences, 582 have additional unreported accession origins, and 53 have reporter origins. The reporter has a misleading human taxonomy tag. Full alternative-parent dependencies precede eligibility.
- Complete-acquisition strict-origin support contains 82 parents, 81 dependency components and 228 potential reference contrasts. These are descriptive feasibility counts: no response effects, reference choice, split, fit or predictive metrics were selected or computed.
- Independent checks replay original quantities, every reference record/span, all 10,647 dependency assignments and three support strata. All 111 required published artifact entries verify against the committed tree. Large original data and derived reference indices remain once locally with paths/hashes. Local tracked lint/format covers 290 files; all eight new source scripts pass isolated checks. A verifier-only EmptyCell failure and narrow recovery are preserved.

Canonical ingestion is implemented in [Hitlist PR #839](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/839). The [independent canonical replay](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/a23bc160a8c31408b82cab663ea968093a624f36/experiments/2026-10-25_0519_codex_native-source-canonical/README.md) verifies all 255,635 quantities, 73,113 full reference records, 38,641 candidate spans, 292,449 original workbook cells and 228,749 parent alternatives through the public store. All 16 primary keys and 28 relationships close; the 1,689 dependency components match the earlier audit. Study-scoped replicate claims remain separate from unresolved per-acquisition pairing. Format/lint and all 3,533 local default tests pass; hosted units pass on Python 3.10–3.14, with integration and tested release pending. [Hitlist #837](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/issues/837) stays open for the registered contrast recipe and biological evaluation. HEK293T support does not establish professional-APC transfer or complete-pool concentrations. No model was trained in these source audits; exact/discrete comparisons follow the planned biological representation screen.

The [workspace recovery](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/5e3a8c033df364d8b67aab352c4e8b2f92dc8ef7/tasks/workspace_recovery_2026-10-25/README.md) restores 1,396 tracked files later found missing from temporary storage and moves the active worktree into durable storage. Cause remains unverified. Primary-checkout fingerprints, 282 prior experiment artifacts and 46 original assets passed recovery checks. Private snapshots and unrelated user changes are excluded from publication. This is separate from the earlier verified cleanup savings.

Hosted checks for this new head are pending; the PR remains draft and the full model goal remains unachieved.
